## setup

```{r}

library(igraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggraph)
library(gridExtra)
library(dplyr)

library(ggplot2)
library(grid)       # arrow()
library(patchwork)  # 拼成三格
library(forcats)

# 讀取資料
node_list <- read_csv("data/node_list.csv")

edge_list <- read_csv("data/edge_list.csv")

# 建立基礎 igraph 物件
net <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edge_list,
  vertices = node_list,   
  directed = TRUE
)
```

## Visualization

```{r}
# 設定顏色與屬性
V(net)$color_role <- case_when(
  V(net)$Role == "Authority" ~ "#3498DB",   # Blue
  V(net)$Role == "Mediator" ~ "#F1C40F",    # Yellow
  V(net)$Role == "Perpetrator" ~ "#E74C3C", # Red
  V(net)$Role == "Victim" ~ "#BDC3C7",      # Grey
  V(net)$Role == "Helper" ~ "purple",       #purple
  V(net)$Role == "Protagonist" ~ "#2ECC71", # Green
  TRUE ~ "white"
)

E(net)$color_rel <- case_when(
  E(net)$Relation_Type == "Positive" ~ "#2ECC71",
  E(net)$Relation_Type == "Negative" ~ "#E74C3C",
  TRUE ~ "#95A5A6"
)

# 子網絡
tw_net <- induced_subgraph(net, V(net)$Culture == "TW")
kr_net <- induced_subgraph(net, V(net)$Culture == "KR")
us_net <- induced_subgraph(net, V(net)$Culture == "US")

# 繪圖函數
plot_culture <- function(sub_net, title) {
  ggraph(sub_net, layout = "fr") + 
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(color = Relation_Type, width = Weight / 30),
      alpha = 0.25,                        
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(2, 'mm')),
      end_cap = circle(0.8, 'mm'),
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
      aes(color = Role),
      size = 3,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    
    #  Role
    geom_node_text(aes(label = Role),
                   repel = TRUE,
                   size = 3,
                   alpha = 0.8) +
    
    scale_edge_color_manual(values = c(
      "Positive" = "#2ECC71",
      "Negative" = "#E74C3C",
      "Neutral"  = "#95A5A6"
    )) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Authority"    = "#3498DB",
      "Mediator"     = "#F1C40F",
      "Perpetrator"  = "#E74C3C",
      "Victim"       = "#BDC3C7",
      "Protagonist"  = "#2ECC71",
      "Helper"       = "#8E44AD",
    ))+
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 1.2)) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      # 調整 legend 標題（Role / Relation_Type）
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
  
       # 調整 legend 內容字體大小
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
  
      # 調整 legend 中 key（小圓點、小線條）大小
      legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      legend.key.width  = unit(1.0, "lines"),
      
      # white background
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

# 出圖
p1 <- plot_culture(tw_net, "Taiwan Network")
p2 <- plot_culture(kr_net, "Korea Network")
p3 <- plot_culture(us_net, "USA Network")

p1
p2
p3
```

```{r}
ggsave("US_network.png", p3, width = 8, height = 6)

ggsave("US_network.svg", p3, width = 10, height = 8)
```

```{r}
# 繪製 3x5 矩陣圖 quick grasp overview
# 排列順序固定為 TW -> KR -> US
edge_list$Weight <- as.numeric(edge_list$Weight)
node_list$Culture <- factor(node_list$Culture, levels = c("TW", "KR", "US"))

# plot the graph
plot_single_story <- function(story_id) {
  
  # 篩選該故事的資料
  sub_nodes <- node_list %>% dplyr::filter(Story_ID == story_id)
  sub_edges <- edge_list %>% dplyr::filter(Story_ID == story_id)
  
  # 建立 igraph 物件
  sub_net <- graph_from_data_frame(d = sub_edges, vertices = sub_nodes, directed = TRUE)
  
  # 計算 Degree (用來決定節點大小)
  V(sub_net)$degree <- degree(sub_net, mode = "all")
  
  # 繪圖
  p <- ggraph(sub_net, layout = "fr", niter = 2000) + 
    
    # 邊 (Edges)
    geom_edge_link(aes(color = Relation_Type, width = Weight), 
                   arrow = arrow(length = unit(2, 'mm'), type = "closed"), 
                   end_cap = circle(6, 'mm'),
                   alpha = 0.3) +
    
    # 節點 (Nodes)
    geom_node_point(aes(color = Role, size = degree)) + 
    
    # 視覺設定
    scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("Positive"="#2ECC71", "Negative"="#E74C3C", "Neutral"="#95A5A6")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Authority"="#3498DB", "Mediator"="#F1C40F", "Perpetrator"="#E74C3C", "Victim"="#95A5A6", "Protagonist"="#2ECC71", "Helper"="#8E44AD")) +
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.8, 2.5), guide = "none") + 
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 8), guide = "none") + 
    
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = story_id) + # 標題只放 Story ID，簡潔
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none", # 單張圖不放 Legend，拼貼時統一放一個大的就好
      # white background
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# 3. 批量生成與存檔迴圈
all_stories <- unique(node_list$Story_ID)

for (sid in all_stories) {
  
  p <- plot_single_story(sid)
  
  # 存為 SVG (向量圖，放大不失真)
  ggsave(filename = paste0(sid, ".svg"), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6)
  
  # 也存一份 PNG 方便預覽
  ggsave(filename = paste0(sid, ".png"), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r}
# Stage-wise network
# 0-1) 鎖住原始 row order
if (!".row" %in% names(edge_list)) {
  edge_list <- edge_list %>% mutate(.row = row_number())
}

# 0-2) edge column
from_col <- "Source"
to_col   <- "Target"

# 0-3) stage column 
stage_col <- "Stage"

# 0-4) 讓 Stage 顯示順序固定
edge_list[[stage_col]] <- factor(edge_list[[stage_col]], levels = c(1,2,3))

plot_story_stagewise <- function(story_id,
                                 layout_algo = "fr",
                                 niter = 2000) {

  sub_nodes <- node_list %>% filter(Story_ID == story_id)
  sub_edges <- edge_list %>% filter(Story_ID == story_id) %>% arrange(.row)

  stages <- levels(sub_edges[[stage_col]])
  if (is.null(stages)) stages <- sort(unique(sub_edges[[stage_col]]))

  plot_one_stage <- function(stg) {
    e <- sub_edges %>% filter(.data[[stage_col]] == stg)
    if (nrow(e) == 0) {
      return(ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = paste("Stage", stg, "(no edges)")))
    }

    g <- graph_from_data_frame(d = e, vertices = sub_nodes, directed = TRUE)
    V(g)$degree <- degree(g, mode = "all")

    ggraph(g, layout = layout_algo, niter = niter) +
      geom_edge_link(aes(color = Relation_Type, width = Weight),
                     arrow = arrow(length = unit(2, "mm"), type = "closed"),
                     end_cap = circle(6, "mm"),
                     alpha = 0.35) +
      geom_node_point(aes(color = Role, size = degree)) +

      scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("Positive"="#2ECC71", "Negative"="#E74C3C", "Neutral"="#95A5A6")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Authority"="#3498DB", "Mediator"="#F1C40F", "Perpetrator"="#E74C3C","Victim"="#95A5A6", "Protagonist"="#2ECC71", "Helper"="#8E44AD")) +
      scale_edge_width(range = c(0.8, 2.5), guide = "none") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 8), guide = "none") +
      theme_void() +
      labs(title = paste0("Stage ", stg)) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey60", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
      )
  }

  p_list <- lapply(stages, plot_one_stage)

  # 拼成三格（像 facet）
  # 在每個 stage 圖中間插入空白 spacer
  p_with_space <- list(
    p_list[[1]],
    plot_spacer(),      # ⬅️ 空白
    p_list[[2]],
    plot_spacer(),      # ⬅️ 空白
    p_list[[3]]
)

  wrap_plots(p_with_space, nrow = 1,
           widths = c(1, 0.15, 1, 0.15, 1)) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0("Story: ", story_id),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  )+
    plot_annotation(title = paste0("Story: ", story_id),
                    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)))
}



```

```{r}
all_stories <- unique(node_list$Story_ID)

for (sid in all_stories) {
  p <- plot_story_stagewise(sid)
  ggsave(paste0(sid, "_stagewise.png"), p, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(paste0(sid, "_stagewise.svg"), p, width = 12, height = 4)
}
```

```{r}
# chain visulaization

# edge_list 裡的欄位
source_col <- "Source"   # 存 Node_ID
target_col <- "Target"   # 存 Node_ID

# node_list 裡的欄位
node_id_col <- "Node_ID"
role_col    <- "Role"

plot_story_sequence <- function(story_id,
                                show_stage_bands = TRUE,
                                label_every_n = 1) {

  e <- edge_list %>%
    filter(Story_ID == story_id) %>%
    arrange(.row) %>%
    mutate(event_id = row_number())

  if (nrow(e) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = paste0("Story: ", story_id, " (no edges)")))
  }

  # 建立 character -> role 對照表
  role_lookup <- node_list %>%
    select(
      Node_ID = !!sym(node_id_col),
      Role    = !!sym(role_col)
      ) %>%
    distinct()

  # 取出 from/to 欄位
  e <- e %>%
  mutate(
    from_node = .data[[source_col]],
    to_node   = .data[[target_col]],
    Stage     = .data[[stage_col]]
  ) %>%
  left_join(role_lookup, by = c("from_node" = "Node_ID")) %>%
  rename(from_role = Role) %>%
  left_join(role_lookup, by = c("to_node" = "Node_ID")) %>%
  rename(to_role = Role)

  # y 軸：用節點出現順序（你也可以改成 alphabet 或 role 分組）
  role_levels <- c("Victim", "Mediator", "Authority",
                 "Helper", "Perpetrator", "Protagonist")

  e <- e %>%
    mutate(
      from = factor(from_role, levels = role_levels),
      to   = factor(to_role,   levels = role_levels)
      )

  # （可選）做 stage 區段底色，讓讀者一眼看到 stage 分界
  stage_ranges <- e %>%
    group_by(Stage) %>%
    summarise(xmin = min(event_id) - 0.5,
              xmax = max(event_id) + 0.5,
              .groups = "drop")
  
  # 找出每個 stage 的結束位置（最後一個 event）
  stage_boundaries <- stage_ranges %>%
    arrange(xmax) %>%
    slice(-n()) %>%        # 最後一個 stage 不需要畫線
    mutate(x = xmax + 0.5)

  p <- ggplot(e) +
    (if (show_stage_bands) {
      geom_rect(data = stage_ranges,
                aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                alpha = 0.08)
    }) +
    
    geom_vline(
      data = stage_boundaries,
      aes(xintercept = x),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.6,
      color = "grey40"
      )+
    
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = event_id, xend = event_id,
          y = from, yend = to,
          color = Relation_Type),   # ✅ 顏色
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(2, "mm"), type = "closed"),
      linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.35
      ) +

    # 可選：每 N 個事件標一個文字（避免太亂）
    geom_text(
      data = e %>% filter(event_id %% label_every_n == 0),
      aes(x = event_id, y = from, label = event_id),
      size = 2.6, vjust = -0.6
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(breaks = e$event_id) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Positive"="#2ECC71", "Negative"="#E74C3C", "Neutral"="#95A5A6")
      ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(alpha = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Sequence Diagram — Story: ", story_id),
      x = "Event order",
      y = "Node (Role)",
      color = "Relation_Type"
    )

  # 在 x 軸上標 Stage 標籤
  if (show_stage_bands) {
    stage_labels <- stage_ranges %>%
      mutate(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2)

    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = stage_labels,
      aes(x = x, y = 1, label = paste0("Stage ", Stage)),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = -1.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3
    )
  }

  p
}
```

```{r}
for (sid in all_stories) {
  p_seq <- plot_story_sequence(sid, show_stage_bands = TRUE, label_every_n = 1)
  ggsave(paste0(sid, "_sequence.png"), p_seq, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(paste0(sid, "_sequence.svg"), p_seq, width = 14, height = 7)
}
```

## RQ 1.

```{r}
calc_centrality <- function(graph) {
  data.frame(
    ID = V(graph)$name,
    Role = V(graph)$Role,
    Gender = V(graph)$Gender,
    Culture = V(graph)$Culture,
    Degree = degree(graph, mode="all"),
    InDegree = degree(graph, mode="in"),
    OutDegree = degree(graph, mode="out"),
    Betweenness = betweenness(graph, directed=TRUE, normalized=TRUE),
    Eigenvector = eigen_centrality(graph)$vector
  )
}

df_metrics <- bind_rows(
  calc_centrality(tw_net),
  calc_centrality(kr_net),
  calc_centrality(us_net)
)

# 聚合數據：依文化與角色計算平均中心性
role_summary <- df_metrics %>%
  group_by(Culture, Role) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Betweenness = mean(Betweenness),
    Avg_Degree = mean(Degree),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
role_summary
```

```{r}
# 只看 Authority & Mediator 的中央性，分文化
role_summary_AM <- df_metrics %>%
  filter(Role %in% c("Authority", "Mediator")) %>%
  group_by(Culture, Role) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Degree = mean(Degree, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Betweenness = mean(Betweenness, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Eigen = mean(Eigenvector, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

role_summary_AM

# 高中央性節點（用 Eigenvector 前 25%）的性別分布
eig_thr <- quantile(df_metrics$Eigenvector, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)


high_power <- df_metrics %>%
  filter(Eigenvector >= eig_thr)


gender_power_AM <- high_power %>%
  filter(Role %in% c("Authority", "Mediator")) %>%
  count(Culture, Role, Gender) %>%
  group_by(Culture, Role) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()
gender_power_AM
```

```{r}
dynamic_analysis_roles <- function(culture_code) {
  
  sub_edges <- edge_list %>% filter(grepl(culture_code, Story_ID))
  sub_nodes <- node_list %>% filter(grepl(culture_code, Story_ID))
  
  stages_data <- list()
  
  for (s in 1:3) {
    
    current_edges <- sub_edges %>% filter(Stage <= s)
    g_temp <- graph_from_data_frame(current_edges, vertices = sub_nodes, directed = TRUE)
    
    df_temp <- data.frame(
      ID         = V(g_temp)$name,
      Role       = V(g_temp)$Role,
      Culture    = culture_code,
      Stage      = s,
      OutDegree  = degree(g_temp, mode = "out"),
      InDegree = degree(g_temp, mode = "in"),
      Degree     = degree(g_temp, mode = "all"),
      Betweenness= betweenness(g_temp, directed = TRUE, normalized = TRUE),
      Eigenvector= eigen_centrality(g_temp)$vector
    )
    
    df_temp <- df_temp %>% filter(Role %in% core_roles)
    
    stages_data[[length(stages_data)+1]] <- df_temp
  }
  
  bind_rows(stages_data)
}

df_dyn <- bind_rows(
  dynamic_analysis_roles("TW"),
  dynamic_analysis_roles("KR"),
  dynamic_analysis_roles("US")
)
```

## RQ3.

```{r}
# 建立角色互動矩陣 (Role-to-Role Interaction Matrix)
get_blockmodel <- function(sub_net) {
  el <- igraph::as_data_frame(sub_net)
  v_attr <- igraph::vertex_attr(sub_net)
  
  # 將 ID 替換為 Role
  el$Source_Role <- v_attr$Role[match(el$from, v_attr$name)]
  el$Target_Role <- v_attr$Role[match(el$to, v_attr$name)]
  
  # 計算互動頻率
  role_mat <- el %>% count(Source_Role, Target_Role)
  return(role_mat)
}

bm_tw <- get_blockmodel(tw_net) %>% mutate(Culture = "TW")
bm_kr <- get_blockmodel(kr_net) %>% mutate(Culture = "KR")
bm_us <- get_blockmodel(us_net) %>% mutate(Culture = "US")

bm_all <- bind_rows(bm_tw, bm_kr, bm_us)
```

```{r}
# Simplified Role-to-Role Interaction Graph (not filtering out low-interactive pattern)

plot_simplified_blockmodel <- function(culture_name) {
  
  # 1. 強制使用 dplyr::filter 避免衝突
  # 確保 edges 資料存在
  
  # 篩選資料 (使用 grepl 確保能抓到 TW01, TW02 等 ID)
  sub_edges <- edge_list %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(culture_name, Story_ID))
  sub_nodes <- node_list %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(culture_name, Story_ID))
  
  # 2. 將 Source/Target ID 替換為 Role
  # 建立查找表 (Lookup table): ID -> Role
  role_lookup <- setNames(sub_nodes$Role, sub_nodes$Node_ID)
  
  sub_edges$Source_Role <- role_lookup[sub_edges$Source]
  sub_edges$Target_Role <- role_lookup[sub_edges$Target]
  
  # 移除找不到 Role 的邊 (避免 NA 錯誤)
  sub_edges <- sub_edges %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(Source_Role) & !is.na(Target_Role))
  
  # 3. 聚合：計算 Role 之間的互動總次數 (Total Weight)
  agg_net <- sub_edges %>%
    group_by(Source_Role, Target_Role, Relation_Type) %>%
    summarise(Total_Weight = sum(as.numeric(Weight)), .groups = 'drop')
  
  # 4. 建立圖形物件
  g_agg <- graph_from_data_frame(agg_net, directed = TRUE)
  
  # 5. 繪圖 (圓形佈局展示互動模式)
  ggraph(g_agg, layout = "circle") + # 圓形佈局
    
    # --- 邊 (Edges) ---
    # 使用 geom_edge_fan: 自動判斷是否需要彎曲
    geom_edge_fan(aes(width = Total_Weight, color = Relation_Type), 
                  arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, 'mm'), type = "closed"), 
                  end_cap = circle(10, 'mm'), # 增加距離，讓箭頭停在空心圓外
                  spread = 0.7, # 控制曲線分開的程度
                  alpha = 0.5) +
    
    # --- 節點 (Nodes) ---
    # shape=21 是實心圓但有邊框。
    # fill="white" 讓它看起來是空心的 (且能遮擋背後的線)
    # stroke=2 設定邊框粗細
    geom_node_point(shape = 21, size = 10, fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 1) +
    
    # --- 標籤 (Labels) ---
    # 黑色字體，放在圓圈中間
    geom_node_text(aes(label = name), color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 2.5) +
    
    # --- 視覺映射 ---
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.8, 2.5)) + 
    scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("Positive"="#2ECC71", "Negative"="#E74C3C", "Neutral"="#95A5A6")) +
    
    # --- 主題與背景 ---
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = paste(culture_name)) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), # 強制白底
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    )
}

# 執行並輸出三張簡化圖
p_block_tw <- plot_simplified_blockmodel("TW")
p_block_kr <- plot_simplified_blockmodel("KR")
p_block_us <- plot_simplified_blockmodel("US")

print(p_block_tw)
print(p_block_kr)
print(p_block_us)
```

```{r}
# Simplified Role-to-Role Interaction Graph (filtering out low-interactive pattern)

plot_simplified_blockmodel_clean <- function(culture_name) {
  
  # 1. 資料準備 (與之前相同)
  sub_edges <- edge_list %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(culture_name, Story_ID))
  sub_nodes <- node_list %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(culture_name, Story_ID))
  
  role_lookup <- setNames(sub_nodes$Role, sub_nodes$Node_ID)
  sub_edges$Source_Role <- role_lookup[sub_edges$Source]
  sub_edges$Target_Role <- role_lookup[sub_edges$Target]
  
  sub_edges <- sub_edges %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(Source_Role) & !is.na(Target_Role))
  
  # 2. 聚合與過濾 (關鍵步驟！)
  # 我們計算每個 Role 對 Role 互動的總強度
  agg_net <- sub_edges %>%
    group_by(Source_Role, Target_Role, Relation_Type) %>%
    summarise(Total_Weight = sum(as.numeric(Weight)), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    # 過濾掉太微弱的連結 (例如 Weight < 3)，只顯示主要互動模式
    filter(Total_Weight >= 3)
  
  # 3. 建立圖形物件
  g_agg <- graph_from_data_frame(agg_net, directed = TRUE)
  
  # 4. 繪圖
  ggraph(g_agg, layout = "circle") + 
    
    # --- 邊 (Edges) ---
    # 使用 geom_edge_fan，並增加透明度
    geom_edge_fan(aes(width = Total_Weight, color = Relation_Type), 
                  arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, 'mm'), type = "closed"), 
                  end_cap = circle(11, 'mm'), # 稍微加大距離，讓箭頭不要碰到圓圈
                  spread = 0.8,               # 讓曲線分開一點
                  alpha = 0.5) +              # 透明度，重疊時才不會變成一坨色塊
    
    # --- 節點 (Nodes) ---
    # 關鍵修正：使用 shape = 21 (可填充顏色的圓)
    # fill = "white" (遮擋背後的線), color = "black" (黑色邊框)
    geom_node_point(shape = 21, size = 10, fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 1) +
    
    # --- 標籤 (Labels) ---
    geom_node_text(aes(label = name), color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 2.5) +
    
    # --- 視覺映射 ---
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.8, 3)) + 
    scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("Positive"="#2ECC71", "Negative"="#E74C3C", "Neutral"="#95A5A6")) +
    
    # --- 主題與背景 ---
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = paste(culture_name)) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
    )
}

# 執行並輸出
p_block_tw_clean <- plot_simplified_blockmodel_clean("TW")
p_block_kr_clean <- plot_simplified_blockmodel_clean("KR")
p_block_us_clean <- plot_simplified_blockmodel_clean("US")

print(p_block_tw_clean)
print(p_block_kr_clean)
print(p_block_us_clean)
```
